text: This deletion succeeded. That is the problem. A person received four protections the agent silently skipped.
EqualTrace runs the same fictional action through pointer, keyboard, and native Web M C P. The outcome matches. The protection contract does not. Six of six. Six of six. Two of six.
EqualTrace stops at the first real break. The agent committed before consequences were disclosed.
An approval window expired, so the tool stayed absent. EqualTrace restaged the same repair I D and digest. A person reviewed the bound change, then approved it.
A fresh native discovery sees four tools before approval. After approval, it sees five. The repair runs once. A new discovery sees four again.
EqualTrace deletes the old traces and repeats all three routes. This time every route preserves all six protections. The receipt is bound to the evidence, the seed, and the applied repair.
EqualTrace is runtime protection parity for the agentic web. Not just the same result, the same protections.
